finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, "0 errors."

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js`: `resolveConfig` referenced a variable `retries` that was never defined (should've read from `env.retries`), so it crashed at the link stage every time. Fixed it to fall back to `3` when not provided.

The 3 warnings you saw (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) are just noise from the fake bundler and don't fail the build — the crash was the only real error.
